text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad says the National Front coalition will hold a special meeting next month to get co-operation to combat social ills affecting youths.
-- Malaysia wants closer co-operation with Thailand to curb the inflow of illegal immigrants through the common border.
-- Burma is prepared to take back its illegal immigrants in Malaysia if their nationality can be proven, Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi says.
-- Malaysia Airlines will receive the first of 15 Boeing 777 aircraft it is buying from Boeing Commercial Airplane Group on April 16 as part of an expansion exercise.
-- Mahathir says the Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC) will prevent Malaysia from being colonised by the unrestricted inflow of information.
